description: Class representing a table of figures.

GetCaption.description: Returns the caption label that the table of figures is built from (for example, "Figure").
GetCaption.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTableOfFigures class.
GetClassType.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetIncludeLabel.description: Returns whether the caption label and number are included in the table of figures entries.
GetIncludeLabel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetCaption.description: Sets the caption label that the table of figures is built from (for example, "Figure").
SetCaption.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetIncludeLabel.description: Specifies whether the caption label and number are included in the table of figures entries.
SetIncludeLabel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetPr.description: Applies the specified properties to the table of figures and rebuilds it.
SetPr.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
